scope: Held-out reference versus official BWM versus rejected trained-adapter comparison
summary: A slowed, labelled three-panel video exposes the measured differences without presenting the rejected adapter as an improvement.
evidence: The local H.264 video decodes at 1344x380, 24 FPS, 67 frames, and 2.791667 seconds; SHA-256 is 49c738bdda47e3fc8a98bb0ff7a2a14639ca7ec05f516537b358e9c8c93b44c5.
A frame-11 visual check shows all three labelled panels with the same robot, bottle, and camera view.
lessons: Reference, baseline, and candidate should be shown together when metric differences are visually subtle.
limitations: The clip is released RoboTwin simulation, not physical-robot footage, and the trained candidate failed promotion.
